rootCause: The three-ply draw guard used an existential search at every turn. It counted a win line even when the opponent could choose a legal defense, so kings-only countdowns could remain at zero indefinitely.

oldWinningLine: Ivory king: 53 to 39, capturing the ebony king
productionResearchPosition.bestDefenseAnalysis: Neither side can force a win within the three-ply proof horizon.

fix: The house-rule proof now searches adversarially: a winning side must be able to force the natural no-legal-move win against every legal defense. It still does not choose moves or force a match result. If the bounded proof runs out of time, the position remains active and is checked again later.
preservation: No changes to src/engine.js, engine evaluation, legal move generation, or arena scheduling. Only the house-rule adjudication proof changed.
regressionCoverage: A kings-only draw countdown expires when neither side can force a win.
A real forced winning capture keeps play alive after the countdown reaches zero.
A potential win that depends on an avoidable opponent blunder no longer blocks the draw.
An exhausted proof budget keeps the match active rather than inventing an outcome.
Every completed player-facing result remains a win or a draw.
supersededResearch: The preliminary 36-bout study in docs/arena-current-live-selector-4c57a08-2026-11-06/ used the defective existential guard and stopped during bout 8. Its partial outcomes are not final fairness evidence; its checkpoint and records are preserved for diagnosis. The current-policy three-season study must restart from bout 1.
